verdict.rationale: Bruno's CLI (bru) lets AI-native users run collections, generate reports, and integrate with CI/CD headlessly (bruno-docs-1,2,3,21,22, bruno-probe-3,4), and collections are stored as plain text files that can be edited directly outside the UI (bruno-docs-9,14). However, many UI-only features—Git UI operations (init/diff/pull/commit), Postman import, mock server config, secrets manager integrations, docs publishing—have no documented CLI/API equivalent, and no REST/OpenAPI API surface exists (bruno-probe-2 confirms no OpenAPI spec). Missing for 10: CLI/API parity for Git operations, import/export, secrets, mocks, and docs generation, plus independent confirmation of full CLI feature coverage.
